title: A message cites only a GitHub comment id that a tool result printed
why: Lane comment-check-scans-shell (session_013NEJL37UFXTQuAcox7s8fD), 21:14 CST Nov 8: it wrote a review-record comment id into a message to the coordinator before the post call returned it. The id was wrong, and it sent a correction. Harm: a session or runner acts on a record that does not exist.
note: Proposed guard: in a send_message body, refuse a GitHub comment id that no earlier tool result in the session printed. Compare steps review-record-post-check and record-variable-id-forms.
